cast_self.notes: defensive self-centred pulse: arms cross, then burst outward

charge_release.notes: forceful cyber-fist punch with weight transfer onto the front foot

charge_start.notes: coil the cyber fist back, accumulate energy

dash_f.notes: ground dash +0 deg: root bone travels 2.0 m (drives the capsule)

dash_r.notes: ground dash -90 deg: root bone travels 2.0 m (drives the capsule)

dead_back.notes: held final pose of death_back (identical to its last frame)

dead_front.notes: held final pose of death_front (identical to its last frame)

death_back.notes: back impact: chest thrown forward, stumbles, knees hit the floor, collapses face down; no hand catch (distinct contacts from death_front)

death_front.notes: front impact: thrown back, stagger step, knees give, falls onto the back (face up)

defeat.notes: nonfatal disappointment: shoulders drop, head shake, hands on hips, exhale

demo_deformation.notes: extra: deformation demonstration poses (not an inventory entry)

deploy.notes: left hand takes the beacon from the back holster, crouches and places it 55 cm ahead

dialogue.notes: spoken performance: 'East lane is mine. Give me ninety seconds, and this whole network stabilizes. Hold on. Something is rewriting the grid from the inside. No. Not on my watch. Hold the line. I'm patching the node myself.'

fall.notes: long-fall posture: arms up and wide, legs apart, looks down

getup_back.notes: sit up on the hands, roll onto the right knee, stand

getup_front.notes: push up with both hands, bring the right knee under, kneel, plant the left foot, stand

greet.notes: two-finger salute from the brow with the organic hand, nod and half smile

hit_b.notes: impact from behind: torso lurches forward; additive relative to frame 0 (combat idle), legs untouched

hit_f.notes: impact from the front: chest and head snap back; additive relative to frame 0 (combat idle), legs untouched

hit_l.notes: impact from the left: bend and twist right; additive relative to frame 0 (combat idle), legs untouched

hit_r.notes: impact from the right: bend and twist left; additive relative to frame 0 (combat idle), legs untouched

idle_combat.notes: ready stance, light bounce, guard adjustments, scanning glances

idle_relaxed.notes: relaxed breathing, weight shifts left/right, glances

idle_wounded.notes: injured but alert: favours the right leg, clutches the ribs, laboured breathing, a wince

jump_air.notes: controllable airborne posture: gentle limb drift, looks toward the landing

jump_land.notes: soft landing: toes first, knees absorb, recover to the stance

jump_start.notes: anticipation crouch with arm back-swing, explosive extension; feet leave the floor at f12 (controller launches the capsule on the 'takeoff' event)

knockback.notes: reaction to host-driven backward travel: braced, bent over the impact, arms thrown forward; the controller moves the capsule back (feet skid visually)

knockdown_back.notes: stagger back, sit down onto the hands, roll onto the back (chin tucked)

knockdown_front.notes: stumble forward onto the knees, hands catch, chest settles face-down

knockup_start.notes: forced launch without anticipation: the body is flung up, legs leave the floor limp

land_heavy.notes: hard landing: deep compression with a left-hand floor touch, heavy recovery

melee_1.notes: diagonal forearm-blade slash high-right to low-left

melee_2.notes: reverse (backhand) slash left-to-right with weight shift onto the front foot then back

melee_3.notes: committed overhead finisher with lunge step and blade retraction

pivot_l180.notes: moving direction change: pivot foot plants, brake step, pivot step +180 deg, push off; world velocity reverses (speed curve), actor yaw follows the turn_yaw curve

pivot_r180.notes: moving direction change: pivot foot plants, brake step, pivot step -180 deg, push off; world velocity reverses (speed curve), actor yaw follows the turn_yaw curve

prone_back.notes: face-up on the floor, restrained breathing

prone_front.notes: face-down on the floor, restrained breathing

ranged_burst.notes: three-shot burst; three distinct muzzle events

ranged_fire.notes: wrist-emitter single shot with recoil; upper-body layer (legs untouched)

reload.notes: left hand pulls the power cell from the cyber-forearm cradle, recharges it on the hip pad, flips and re-seats it; cell parent switches at grab/seat frames

respawn.notes: reconstruct kneeling with head down, power up, rise and settle into the ready stance

run_r.notes: run cycle, travel -90 deg rel. facing, stride 2.80 m

sleep_end.notes: startled awake: head snaps up, eyes open, rises to readiness

sleep_loop.notes: sustained sleep: slow breathing and slight head nod

sleep_start.notes: drowsy: head drops, knees fold, settles into a stable kneeling sleep posture

sprint_f.notes: sprint cycle, travel +0 deg rel. facing, stride 4.12 m

start_f.notes: accelerate from stand: lean, left step, right step into the walk cycle (exit phase 0.516)

stop_f.notes: brake from walk (enter at left heel strike): right foot plants beside, weight settles back

stun_end.notes: shake it off and regain control without sliding the feet

stun_loop.notes: disoriented: head circles, body sways, breathing; feet planted

stun_start.notes: lose control: jolt, head snaps, knees buckle into the dazed stance

turn_l90.notes: turn +90 deg in place with two steps; the body rotates relative to the root, the controller rotates the actor by the same amount (turn_yaw curve) and counter-rotates the mesh

turn_r90.notes: turn -90 deg in place with two steps; the body rotates relative to the root, the controller rotates the actor by the same amount (turn_yaw curve) and counter-rotates the mesh

uplink_end.notes: successful completion cue: final tap, flourish, nod

uplink_loop.notes: sustained console input: taps, feet planted

uplink_start.notes: raise the cyber forearm console; left index finger begins the recall sequence

victory.notes: cyber fist pump, glowing grin, then a confident arms-crossed stance
